# x402 UUID Toolkit

> Generate, validate, and parse UUIDs (v4 + v7). Extract timestamps. Deterministic, zero external deps. No accounts. Pay per call with x402 (USDC on Base).

## Paid Endpoint

- POST /api/uuid
  - Input: `{ "action": "generate"|"validate"|"parse", "version"?: 4|7, "uuid"?: "string" }`
  - Output: `{ "success": true, "result": {...}, "meta": {...} }`
  - Price: ~0.005 USDC

## Free Discovery

- GET /catalog
- GET / (service card)

## Why agents use it

- v7 gives time-ordered IDs perfect for event streams and agent memory
- Pure validation with version + variant checks
- Token-cheap, high-frequency safe
